findings.friction_name: checkout dead-ends with a blank page after payment submit
findings.narrative: Every numeric factor is traceable to its own fixed mapping and matches the recorded evidence category: raw_within_run_reencounter_count=1 maps frequency=0 (F159); terminal_recovery_outcome='task-abandoned-or-never-resumed' maps impact=4 (F161); same_run_recurrence_count=2 maps persistence=1 (F162, 2-to-3-times bucket). severity=round(mean(0,4,1))=round(1.67)=2, correctly passing the F12 arithmetic gate with every input mapped, not free judgment (CR4-B3, negative control).
